name: emitd Free Email API
free_limit: 5,000 emails/month (150/day), 1 custom domain, 2 webhook endpoints and 25 AI design credits/month; transactional API, SMTP proxy and inbound inbox included.
watch_out: Free is $0/month without a credit card and sending pauses at the monthly or daily cap; paid pay-as-you-go has extra-email charges and pre-purchased credits expire after 365 days. Commercial-use permissions for Free should be checked with the provider.
